items: Useful Peonies Cages and Supports：Half round design make it easy to fit around the plants, just attach 2pcs together to support your plant,reates a well ordered border, provides ample support for heavy plants, flowers and shrubbery, keeping paths open and wide. 10inch diameter by 24inch height will be supporting plants up to 4ft.

items.label: Sturdy Material
items.value: These peony cage made of sturdy iron wire in 4.0mm diameter with green powder coating,which better than others that in cheap plastic coated or any wood support stakes. will last long time even using under sun and rain.It not easy to deform, stand firmly, well support and protect plants.

items.label: Wide Applications
items.value: 10 inch wide x 24 inch high Large peonies cages and supports can fit most bushy plants like hydrangeas, roses, peonies, salvias, cone flowers, etc. tomato plants and vine plants like cherry tomato, etc. Also can be used as border to keep pathways open in your garden.

items.label: Easy to use
items.value: Push the garden support stakes into the ground, used as a single half or interlinked to form rows,circles, cloverleaves etc, ell prop up plants to grow upright and healthily, It can be detached and reused, can be overlapped.

items.label: Package includes
items.value: 12 pieces 10" Wide x 24" High plant support stakes and with Plant Label of 20 pcs & plants feet garden twist tie. The Plant ring cage in dark green help it to blend into green plants.
